correctness.rationale: For the fixed original map, each of the two branches maps its half of the box onto the box up to its boundary, and has absolute Jacobian determinant 2. Backward iteration gives every length-n word mass 2^(-n), independently confirming STY (P4). The branch matrices are signed monomial; at each step exactly the column occupying output row 1 after the shift has its magnitude doubled. With input coordinate j=1+((-r) mod M) this gives the occupation count of post-step residue r. Multiplying by z_r on arrival gives the claimed row-vector PGF; at M=3,n=2 the four fair words give the four distinct monomials printed in the result. The Poisson relation (I−P)g_i=f_i gives increments (1−2S_j)f_i(R_(j−1)) and endpoint term Pg_i(R_0)−Pg_i(R_n), bounded by the oscillation 2(M−1)/M. Irreducibility and holding give ergodicity and uniform stationary occupation; the predictable covariance limit is I/M−11^T/M² and boundedness verifies martingale Lindeberg. Independently, every nonconstant Fourier eigenvalue λ=(1+ω)/2 has Re[λ/(1−λ)]=0, so the lag-covariance correction vanishes on the mean-zero subspace. The Euclidean range gives the condition-number law, and martingale orthogonality bounds the second moment of the normalized centered vector, so normalized ranges are uniformly integrable. For M=3, integration by parts gives E max Z_i=3∫φΦ²x dx=6∫φ²Φ dx=3/(2√π), hence the stated mean. Ergodicity also gives the common almost-sure growth rate. Read VERIFICATION.md and verify_twisted.py, not executed. The quoted 10,330 is a recorded count, not a fresh replay. The script actually loops over M=2 through 6 in the covariance check as well, not 2 through 8 as RESULT.md line 84 says. That does not affect the all-fixed-M proof.
